title: General Manager Operations and Business Development
description:
Role Overview 
 The General Manager Operations & Business Development will be responsible for the overall coordination and supervision of the companys day-to-day office operations. The selected candidate will allocate responsibilities to employees, monitor the progress of important assignments, coordinate between different departments and ensure that tasks are completed within the required timelines. In addition to internal office management, the candidate will represent NR Marines LLP in meetings with customers, government departments, shipyards, maritime organisations, OEMs, business partners and other stakeholders. The candidate will also be responsible for identifying new opportunities, developing professional relationships and supporting the expansion of the company’s business. This is a hands-on leadership position and not merely an advisory or administrative role. The candidate must be willing and able to manage the office while also travelling for meetings, customer visits and business-development activities. 
 Key Responsibilities Office Operations and Administration 
 Manage and supervise the day-to-day functioning of the office. Allocate responsibilities to employees according to their capabilities and organisational priorities. Monitor the progress of assigned work and ensure timely completion. Establish effective systems for reporting, follow-up and accountability. Conduct regular reviews with team members regarding pending and priority matters. Coordinate between tendering, procurement, engineering, logistics, accounts, documentation and service-support functions. Monitor important correspondence, enquiries, tenders, purchase orders, inspections, dispatches, payments and project deadlines. Ensure that customer requirements and management instructions are properly communicated and implemented. Identify operational delays or bottlenecks and take timely corrective action. Maintain professional discipline, punctuality and accountability within the office. Handle urgent, sensitive or challenging situations confidently and practically. Provide regular operational updates and reports to the management. Team Leadership and Supervision Lead, guide and supervise office personnel. Ensure proper allocation of work and clarity of individual responsibilities. Improve coordination between employees and departments. Review employee performance and identify areas requiring improvement. Motivate team members and encourage responsibility and ownership. Train junior employees in professional communication, customer handling, follow-up and documentation. Ensure that important matters are followed up consistently and do not remain unattended. Promote a professional, disciplined and result-oriented working environment. Act as a dependable senior point of contact for both employees and external stakeholders. 
 Business Development and Expansion 
 Identify new business opportunities in the marine, shipbuilding, government, industrial and engineering sectors. Develop and maintain relationships with existing and prospective customers. Meet representatives of shipyards, government departments, maritime organisations, OEMs, consultants and private-sector companies. Represent NR Marines LLP during customer meetings, commercial discussions, exhibitions, conferences and industry events. Conduct regular visits to customers, project locations and partner organisations. Follow up on enquiries, proposals, tenders and ongoing commercial opportunities. Support the management in developing and implementing business-growth strategies. Identify new products, markets, OEMs, technology partners and business associates. Assist in commercial negotiations and support the conversion of opportunities into confirmed orders. Monitor upcoming projects, procurement plans, market developments and competitor activities. Maintain a structured record of leads, meetings, enquiries and business opportunities. Submit periodic reports on customer engagement, business-development activities and expected order conversions. Help expand the company’s presence across relevant government and private-sector markets. 
 Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate should be a mature, dependable and energetic professional with a strong personality and leadership presence. The candidate must possess: Excellent spoken and written English communication skills. Strong confidence, interpersonal skills and professional presentation. Proven ability to lead teams, allocate responsibilities and monitor performance. Ability to communicate comfortably with senior government officials, defence personnel, shipyard representatives, business owners and technical professionals. Strong administrative, organisational and follow-up capabilities. Commercial awareness and a genuine interest in business development. Ability to conduct meetings and negotiations independently. Ability to handle difficult situations calmly and take practical decisions. Good working knowledge of email communication, Microsoft Office, presentations and reporting systems. Willingness to travel for customer meetings, project coordination and business-development activities. High standards of integrity, confidentiality and professional conduct. A hands-on, solution-oriented and result-driven approach. 
 Preferred Professional Background 
 Preference will be given to candidates having experience in one or more of the following areas: Retired Commissioned Officer from the Indian Navy, Indian Coast Guard, Indian Army or Indian Air Force. Retired defence personnel with experience in administration, operations, logistics, procurement, engineering, maintenance or commercial coordination. Merchant Navy Captain, Chief Engineer, Marine Engineer or other experienced maritime professional seeking a shore-based leadership role. Senior professional from a shipyard, marine-equipment company, engineering organisation, government contractor or industrial organisation. Professional with established contacts in the marine, shipbuilding, government or industrial sectors. A marine, naval or merchant-navy background will be a strong advantage but is not mandatory. Candidates from other professional backgrounds may also be considered if they possess excellent leadership, office-management and business-development capabilities. Educational Qualifications Graduate in any discipline from a recognised university or institution. Qualifications in Engineering, Marine Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, Logistics or Management will be preferred. Candidates with substantial defence, maritime or leadership experience may be considered based on their overall professional credentials. 
 Experience Requirements 
 Minimum 15 years of overall professional experience. Experience in team leadership, office administration, operations, customer coordination or business development is essential. Previous exposure to government organisations, shipyards, marine companies, engineering firms or institutional customers will be preferred. Retired defence officers and experienced merchant-navy professionals transitioning into a shore-based leadership position are encouraged to apply. 
 Key Performance Areas 
 The candidate’s performance will be assessed primarily on: Efficiency and discipline of office operations. Timely allocation and completion of work. Improvement in internal coordination and accountability. Effective monitoring of tenders, orders, inspections, dispatches and payments. Quality and frequency of customer engagement. Identification and development of new business opportunities. Conversion of leads into enquiries, tenders and confirmed orders. Expansion of the company’s customer and partner network. Effective resolution of operational and customer-related matters. 
 What We Offer 
 A senior leadership position with direct access to the management. Responsibility and authority to improve office systems and team performance. An opportunity to contribute directly to the growth and expansion of NR Marines LLP. Exposure to marine, shipbuilding, government and specialised engineering projects. A professional role combining operations, leadership, customer engagement and business development. Remuneration based on the candidate’s experience, professional background and capabilities. 
 Application Requirements 
 Interested candidates should apply with an updated CV and provide the following information: Current location. Present and expected remuneration. Notice period or earliest joining date. Details of defence, maritime, shipyard, government or industrial experience, if applicable. Brief description of team-management and business-development experience. Willingness to travel for customer meetings and official assignments.

description:

 Role Snapshot 
 Company Swaran Soft Support Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Division Agentic AI & Application Development Sales Openings Senior (610 yrs) Target Markets India Location Gurugram HQ Employment Type Full-Time Apply To hr@swaransoft.com Know More www.swaransoft.com 
 About Swaran Soft 
Swaran Soft is an enterprise AI and digital transformation company headquartered in Gurugram, India, with offices in the UAE, Estonia, and the USA. Our Agentic AI Consulting & Managed Services division our fastest-growing practice builds intelligent automation platforms for large Indian and Middle Eastern enterprises across BFSI, telecom, healthcare, and manufacturing.
 
We combine open-source infrastructure, India-localised AI (including sovereign models such as Sarvam AI, BharatGen, and Krutrim), and deep integrations with WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, CRM, and telephony stacks to deliver AI that speaks the enterprise's language literally.
 
Our entry point with clients is a fixed-fee, 8-week Agentic AI pilot a no-competition proposition that gives enterprise buyers a low-risk path to demonstrable ROI. Beyond pilots, we offer full rollout, managed services, and custom application development.
 
Visit www.swaransoft.com to explore our services, case studies, and what life looks like at Swaran Soft.
 
 The Role 
This is a consultative, solution-selling role not a product sales job. You will be selling transformation, not licences. Your buyers are CXOs, IT Heads, and VP-level decision-makers at mid-to-large enterprises who are evaluating Agentic AI as a genuine business lever.
 
You will own the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, solution design conversations, proposal development, stakeholder navigation, and deal closure. You will work closely with our technical consulting team to shape pilot proposals and full-scale AI transformation roadmaps.
 
If you have sold complex technology solutions to enterprise clients and want to now sell AI at the frontier where every conversation is about genuine business impact this role was built for you.
 
 
 What You Will Sell 
1) Agentic AI Consulting & Implementation end-to-end intelligent workflow automation for enterprises
2) Fixed-Fee 8-Week Agentic AI Pilot our flagship entry proposition with defined scope and measurable outcomes
3) Managed AI Services ongoing LLM tuning, agent monitoring, SLA-backed support, and performance optimisation
4) Custom Application Development enterprise-grade applications built on open-source and cloud-native stacks
5) India-Localised AI Solutions multilingual AI agents supporting Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and 9+ Indian languages
6) Enterprise Integrations WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, CRM (Zoho, Freshdesk, ServiceNow), and telephony (Exotel, Twilio)
7) Voice AI & Conversational Automation AI-powered call handling, transcription, sentiment analysis, and escalation
8) AI for Middle East Enterprises sovereign-data-compliant, VPC and on-premise deployable AI platforms 
 Senior Enterprise Sales Manager / Business Development Lead (6-10 Years Experience) 
 You are a seasoned enterprise sales professional who has closed large, complex, multi-stakeholder technology deals. You can build a territory from scratch, manage a team, and represent Swaran Soft at the most senior levels of enterprise engagement in India and the Middle East. 
 Responsibilities 
 Own and grow Swaran Soft's enterprise sales pipeline across India and Middle East markets
¢ Build and manage strategic relationships with CXO, CDO, CISO, and IT leadership at target enterprise accounts
¢ Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial qualification through commercial closure
¢ Structure and negotiate enterprise contracts, managed service agreements, and multi-year transformation engagements
¢ Develop and execute a territory plan covering key verticals, geographies, and account clusters
¢ Mentor and guide junior sales executives build a high-performing, process-driven sales team
¢ Partner with the technical consulting team on solution architecture, pilot design, and RFP responses
¢ Lead Swaran Soft's participation in enterprise events, AI summits, and CXO forums in India and the UAE
¢ Provide market intelligence and competitive positioning inputs to the leadership team
¢ Own revenue targets with full accountability for pipeline conversion and quarterly bookings
 Must-Have Skills & Background 
¢ 610 years of enterprise technology sales, with a strong record closing 50L5Cr+ deals
¢ Proven experience in solution or consultative selling of IT services, AI, cloud, or digital transformation
¢ Deep enterprise network in India preferably across BFSI, telecom, healthcare, or manufacturing
¢ Ability to navigate complex procurement, legal, and multi-stakeholder buying processes
¢ Demonstrated experience building and leading small-to-mid enterprise sales teams
¢ Strong commercial acumen able to structure multi-year deals, SLA-backed managed service contracts, and pilots
¢ Excellent executive presence and communication boardroom-ready presentations and proposal leadership
¢ Experience managing CRM pipelines, forecasting, and revenue reporting at a senior level
 Good to Have 
¢ Prior experience in AI, agentic automation, intelligent process automation, or enterprise AI platforms
¢ Existing relationships with enterprise IT decision-makers in the UAE, KSA, or broader GCC region
¢ Exposure to Indian sovereign AI landscape Sarvam AI, BharatGen, or comparable models
¢ Background in selling open-source or hybrid cloud enterprise technology stacks
¢ Experience with multilingual or India-localised enterprise software propositions
 
 The Profile We Are Looking For 
We are not looking for someone who sells from a brochure. We are looking for a sales professional who can hold a conversation with a CTO about intelligent workflow orchestration, and in the same breath, explain to a CFO why the 8-week fixed-fee pilot de-risks the entire AI investment.
 
You are genuinely curious about AI not as a buzzword, but as a capability you understand well enough to have a credible technical conversation. You are organised, pipeline-obsessed, and you close.
 
 What We Offer 
1) Competitive fixed salary + uncapped performance-linked incentives aligned to deal value
2) Sell a product with genuine differentiation India-first, multilingual, open-source Agentic AI
3) Short sales cycles supported by a fixed-fee 8-week pilot a proven enterprise door-opener
4) Access to warm inbound leads through Swaran Soft's SEO and GEO-led digital presence
5) Work directly with a founder-led leadership team fast decisions, no bureaucracy
6) Flexible working from Gurugram HQ with remote-friendly policy and UAE posting option
7) Travel and entertainment budget for enterprise client engagement and industry events
8) Clear growth path high performers move into Practice Lead, Head of Sales, or Regional Director roles
9) Learning budget for AI certifications, sales training, and industry conferences
 
 Life at Swaran Soft 
At Swaran Soft, sales is not a support function it is a growth engine. Our sales professionals sit at the leadership table, shape our go-to-market strategy, and have a direct line to the Founder and CEO.
 
We are a team that builds in the open, shares wins honestly, and learns from every client conversation. Our culture rewards ownership, intellectual honesty, and the ability to simplify the complex which is, after all, what Tech Simplified means.
 
Visit www.swaransoft.com to explore our work, our team, and what it looks like to be part of an AI-first company that is building for India's most complex enterprises.

Job Title: Business Development Executive Government & Municipal Sales 
 Company: Neerova.ai – A Cosmos Pumps Group Company 
 Location: Faridabad, Haryana 
 Experience: 1–4 Years 
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 Department: Business Development / Sales 
 Reporting To: Chief Growth Officer 
 Job Summary: 
 We are looking for a Business Development Executive to drive government and municipal sales opportunities for Neerova.ai , focused on urban flood mitigation, dewatering, IoT, SCADA and intelligent water infrastructure. The role involves identifying upcoming government projects and tenders, mapping key decision-makers, developing institutional relationships, generating qualified leads and arranging meetings with senior leadership. 
 Key Responsibilities: Track GeM, CPPP and state e-procurement portals for relevant tenders and projects. Research upcoming government schemes, sanctions, municipal budgets and infrastructure projects. Identify and map Municipal Commissioners, Chief Engineers, Executive Engineers and other key government stakeholders. Build relationships with contractors, consultants, DPR firms, system integrators and channel partners. Conduct outreach through calls, emails and LinkedIn. Generate qualified leads and schedule meetings with the CEO/CGO. Prepare meeting briefs and coordinate meeting logistics. Follow up on meetings, proposals and opportunities until closure. Maintain an updated sales/pipeline tracker with next actions and timelines. Share a weekly update on new opportunities, tenders and pipeline status. 
 Candidate Profile: 1–4 years of experience in B2B sales, government sales, inside sales, lead generation or bid coordination. Experience in infrastructure, industrial products, engineering services or technology is preferred. Fresh graduates with strong communication, research and business development skills may also be considered. Graduate in any discipline; technical/engineering background will be an advantage. Comfortable communicating with senior government officials. Strong persistence, follow-up and relationship-building skills. Fluent Hindi and good written English. Strong research skills with the ability to work on tender portals, government websites and official documents. Good working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/pipeline trackers. 
 Preferred Skills: Exposure to pumps, water/drainage infrastructure, SCADA, IoT or municipal projects. Knowledge of government procurement, including L1/QCBS, EMD and technical/commercial bidding. Knowledge of an additional regional language such as Bengali, Odia, Marathi or Gujarati. 
 What You Will Achieve: 30 Days: Understand the product and start delivering the weekly tender/opportunity tracker. 60 Days: Maintain the pipeline as the central tracker and generate the first qualified meetings. 90 Days: Build a consistent flow of qualified meetings, identify at least two city-level partners and ensure timely follow-ups. 
 About Neerova.ai: 
 Neerova.ai is a Cosmos Pumps group company building intelligent water infrastructure solutions. Its FloodCTRL platform combines IoT, SCADA and automated dewatering capabilities to help cities predict and respond to urban waterlogging and flooding.

Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

  

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

 **AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.  

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you. **About the Role**  

The person should have excellent communication skills (both verbal and written) to communicate with the internal \& external team and comprehend client’s requirement from the written communication. The person should be willing to work in the as per business requirement also have a zeal to perform in a fast\-paced environment and willingness to thrive for an award\-winning career. Would require experience in Sales compensation/Commissions.
In This Role, You Will::
* Manage monthly, quarterly, and annual commissions and incentives for an international team of direct and indirect salespeople. This may include processing commissions for advanced incentive plans as well as overseeing the execution of commissions related processes across the team
* Independently drive process execution to ensure consistency and quality across the commissions team
* Work with senior Sales leadership to define, create and distribute Sales management incentive plans
* Independently drive annual sales process, including plan creation (both annual and ad\-hoc) and annual, quarterly and ad\-hoc reporting
* Listen to, triage, process and resolve questions from the Sales team and serve as the primary point of contact regarding the calculation of their commission.
* Maintain accurate quotas and rates for the Sales compensation plans.
* Manage plan exception requests and escalate as required.
* Conduct regular reviews of commission data to ensure accuracy.
* Close coordination with sales managers to establish and maintain proper quality controls.
* Provide operational analysis, reporting and trends related to commissions, compensation plans, and other Sales and commission related data.
* Drive automation of the commission and incentive calculation process.
* Research and analyze data to prepare employee compensation reports for management.
* Create and maintain procedural documents to describe operational processes.
* Make continuous process improvements to seek further efficiencies. Customer\-centric focus with a desire to generate high quality, custom work


Here's What You Need::
* An interest in sales compensation and a desire to work in a high energy, fast paced environment
* Strong with Advanced Excel and VBA. Experience of working on a commission software/tool would be an added advantage (Xactly, Anaplan, Callidus or similar)
* Exceptional time management skills and an ability to handle multiple assignments and meet deadlines
* Excellent organization, multitasking, and prioritization skills, with a focus on attention to detail and delivering of high\-quality results
* Exceptional Microsoft Excel skills required
* Salesforce.com experience along with Sales compensation is desired
* A ‘systems’ thinker with a process orientation
* Superior interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
* Must be a proactive, possess a high degree of intellectual curiosity and a self\-driven learner
* Ability to work independently and with a team
* Graduated with exceptional performance in undergraduate academics
* 5\-10 years of relevant experience (ideally in an analyst or lead analyst role) with a strong work ethic

description:
ROLE OVERVIEW The Associate Client Engagement Manager works alongside the senior Client Engagement Manager to drive Celebal's commercial and client engagement activity across the GCC primarily Saudi Arabia and the UAE — with a clear path to owning accounts and transactions outright. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, but it is not a coordination role. You will be expected to hold your own in a first conversation with a Microsoft solution specialist or a client stakeholder without a technical colleague on the call, to explain what Celebal does differently in a specific solution area, and to build and defend a commercial estimate. Pre-sales, delivery and practice teams support you; they do not substitute for you. Read this before applying: the interview includes a live technical and commercial assessment. Candidates who position themselves as functional or relationship-only sellers, and who require pre-sales support for every solution conversation, are not a fit for this role — regardless of years of experience or account pedigree. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Pipeline Ownership & Deal Progression Own and progress a defined slice of the GCC opportunity pipeline — from qualification through proposal submission, negotiation support and closure — with the senior CEM as escalation point rather than as approver of every step. Run RFP, RFI and tender responses end to end: interpret requirements, decompose the scope, own the response plan and timeline, drive contributions from pre-sales and practice leads, and assemble a submission that is compliant and commercially sound. Manage Microsoft and partner co-sell motions directly — deal registration, co-sell submissions, MCI/ECIF and pre-sales funding nominations, and joint account planning with Microsoft SSPs, ATUs and partner leads (Crayon and others). Maintain CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy and pipeline reporting to a standard that leadership can act on without rework. Schedule and lead client meetings, demos and technical presentations; author the meeting narrative and the follow-up MOM, not just the logistics. 2. Client Engagement & Account Ownership Act as a named point of contact for assigned accounts, holding day-to-day commercial and delivery-liaison conversations independently. Produce client-facing material — proposals, BoQ and BoM summaries, executive briefings, project status narratives — in a form that goes to the client with light review, not heavy rewriting. Track milestone status with delivery, trigger milestone-linked commercial actions, and own invoicing follow-up, collections escalation and revenue realisation for your accounts. Maintain complete, auditable engagement documentation: MSAs, SOWs, Change Requests, LOIs, correspondence and approval trails. 3. Solution Positioning & Differentiation Articulate what Celebal does differently in specific solution areas — Microsoft Fabric and Databricks-based data platform modernisation, migration accelerators, GenAI and agentic use cases, sovereign cloud and security — and why that beats an incumbent system integrator. This is a core competency of the role, not a marketing hand-off. Maintain and actively use the GCC solution narrative: capability decks, reference architectures, case studies, industry-specific use-case libraries and competitive positioning. Translate a client problem statement into an indicative solution shape and commercial envelope in the room, then validate it with pre-sales — rather than deferring the entire conversation. 4. Proposal, Estimation & Commercial Construction Author the executive summary, scope of work, assumptions, exclusions and commercial sections of proposals; source tech stack, effort estimates and delivery timelines from pre-sales and delivery and integrate them coherently. Build and adjust Azure consumption estimates independently using the Azure pricing calculator — storage, compute, capacity SKUs and licensing — and understand how those choices move the client's total cost. Draft quotations, SOW summaries and Change Request documentation; understand the difference between T&M, fixed-price, managed-capacity and outcome-based structures and when each is appropriate. 5. Internal Coordination & Governance Liaise with delivery, legal, finance and HR on engagement onboarding, commercial issue resolution and contract execution. Prepare internal briefing notes, commercial summaries, deal review packs and escalation memos of a standard suitable for regional leadership review. Contribute to WBS updates, revenue forecasting and weekly/monthly business reviews. Ensure clean account handovers with full context and documentation captured. 
 QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Essential — screened against, no exceptions GCC market experience. 4–6 years in B2B technology sales, client engagement, pre-sales or account management, including demonstrable UAE and/or KSA market experience — in-market work history, or documented ownership of GCC-based client relationships. Regional exposure gained purely through remote channel coordination does not meet this requirement. Microsoft partner ecosystem depth. Hands-on experience with co-sell motions, deal registration, and pre-sales or partner funding mechanisms (MCI, ECIF or equivalent), including working relationships with Microsoft field roles (SSP, ATU, partner development). Data & AI portfolio literacy. Working knowledge of the Microsoft data and AI stack — Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, GenAI/Copilot patterns — sufficient to scope a data platform, migration or AI use-case conversation unaided. Cloud and security fundamentals. Practical fluency in Azure architecture basics, M365/O365, and Microsoft security and compliance (Sentinel, Defender, identity). Certification at fundamentals level or above (AZ-900, MS-900, SC-900, DP-900 or higher) is expected; equivalent demonstrated knowledge is acceptable. Estimation capability. Able to build and defend an Azure consumption estimate on the Azure pricing calculator without pre-sales assistance. This is tested live during interview. RFP and tender ownership. Direct experience running or substantially owning RFP, RFI or government tender responses, including compliance and commercial sections. Services-commercial exposure. Familiarity with MSAs, SOWs and Change Requests, and with authoring scope and commercial terms for services engagements — as distinct from licensing or product resale. Deal scale. Experience on engagements where individual proof-of-concept values reach USD 150K or above and multi-year programmes exceed USD 1M. Celebal proof-of-concept engagements alone routinely run USD 200K–250K. Applied AI fluency. Uses AI tooling deliberately in the sales craft — research, account intelligence, first-draft proposal and RFP response construction, competitive analysis — with judgement about what must still be authored and verified by a human. Communication. Clear, professional written and spoken English; able to produce client-ready correspondence and documents with minimal supervision. Education. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. MBA or a technical postgraduate qualification is an advantage. Mobility. Based in or willing to relocate to Dubai, with a valid ability to travel across KSA and the GCC. Preferred Arabic language capability. Prior employment with a Microsoft partner, system integrator or technology consulting firm serving enterprise clients in the region. Account experience in logistics, government or public sector, FMCG, or financial services in the GCC. Exposure to sovereign cloud, data residency or regional compliance requirements (SDAIA, NDMO, UAE data protection). Experience with CRM and revenue tooling — Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clari. Familiarity with government procurement portals and tender platforms in KSA or the UAE. 
 COMPETENCIES Technical credibility. Can hold a solution conversation with an architect or Microsoft specialist and be taken seriously. This is the single most important competency in the role. Commercial judgement. Understands deal structures, pricing models, margin implications and revenue recognition well enough to shape a deal, not just document it. Independent ownership. Moves an opportunity forward without waiting to be told the next step; escalates with a recommendation attached. Competitive framing. Can explain why Celebal, in a specific solution area, against a specific incumbent, in under two minutes. Organisational rigour. Manages concurrent engagements with accurate documentation, clean CRM and reliable follow-through. Stakeholder navigation. Comfortable across pre-sales, delivery, legal and finance internally, and across client procurement, IT and business stakeholders externally. Cross-cultural effectiveness. Operates credibly in GCC business culture and with distributed India-based delivery teams. Adaptability. Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth regional business with evolving priorities. 
 SELECTION PROCESS Candidates should expect a structured assessment rather than a conversational interview. The process comprises an HR screening, a technical and commercial round with sales leadership, and a regional fit discussion. What we assess 
 How Solution positioning 
 You will be asked to pitch Celebal cold to a Microsoft SSP covering a named industry, and to answer why a client should move work to us from an incumbent SI. Generic value statements do not clear this stage. Commercial sizing 
 You will be asked to open the Azure pricing calculator on screen and build or adjust a simple estimate — storage, compute, capacity SKU — without pre-sales support. Solution depth 
 You will be asked to walk through the most technically complex engagement you have sold, including data sources, integration approach and platform choices, in your own words. Commercial structure 
 You will be asked how a proposal is assembled — which sections you author, which you source from pre-sales and delivery, and how pricing model and timelines are arrived at. 
 CAREER PATH This role is a structured route into a full Client Engagement Manager position. Candidates who demonstrate technical credibility, commercial judgement and independent account ownership will be considered for progression within 18–24 months. Progression is assessed on independent deal ownership and solution credibility, not tenure. 
 WHAT WE OFFER Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives. Direct exposure to marquee enterprise and government accounts across the GCC. Close collaboration with Microsoft field and product teams, including global initiative and sovereign cloud programmes. Structured mentorship from experienced regional sales leadership. Funded certification pathways across Azure, Data & AI, and Security. Fast-track growth in a priority geography, within a global team spanning the Americas, EMEA, India, APJ, Australia and Japan.

 We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
   

  

 Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

 Meeting Business Targets

 Planning \& Reports

* undefined


 Product support
   

  

* Offer product support to customers

* Support product marketing team for product promotion, market data \& business development initiatives in the region


 Payment Collection
   

  

* Follow up with customers for payment \& monitor their current outstanding payments regularly for ensuring that credit exposure stays under control

 Business Development
   

  

* Regularly travel in the market to meet contractors, SSI OEMs, WHS \& Institutional customers

* Keep the market updated about new products \& technologies, taking sustainable \& specific efforts for introducing them in the market for long term business.


**Our Commitment to Our People**
 Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
   

  

 Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal \- to make the world a better place. We invest in the end\-to\-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
   

  

 Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
   

  

 Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
   

  

**Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging**
 At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

title: Business Development Manager | IT Services, AI Solutions
description:
About the Role 
 We are an AI-native software and consulting company that works with businesses to identify operational problems and build AI, automation, and custom software solutions around them. 
 We are looking for a **Business Development Manager** who can help us build our outbound sales engine from the ground up. 
 This is not a traditional lead-generation role where your job is to download thousands of contacts from Apollo and send generic emails. 
 You will be responsible for figuring out: 
 * Which industries and ICPs we should target * Which companies within those markets are worth approaching * Who the right decision-makers are * What messaging and offers resonate with them * Which outbound channels work best * How to consistently generate qualified sales conversations 
 You will work directly with the founder and will have significant ownership over the company's GTM strategy. 
 ## What You Will Do 
 ### Build Outbound Pipeline 
 Own outbound prospecting across channels including: 
 * Cold calling * Cold email * LinkedIn outreach * Account-based prospecting * Follow-ups and multi-channel sequences 
 Your objective is not simply to book meetings. 
 Your objective is to generate **qualified sales conversations and real business opportunities**. 
 Test Different ICPs and Markets 
 We will continuously test different industries and customer segments. 
 You will be responsible for: 
 * Researching industries and customer segments * Developing ICP hypotheses * Identifying relevant companies and decision-makers * Creating and launching outbound campaigns * Testing different messaging and offers * Measuring results * Killing campaigns that do not work * Doubling down on campaigns that show traction 
 You should be comfortable operating in an environment where the perfect sales playbook does not already exist. 
 Run Modern Outbound 
 We do not believe that simply scraping leads from Apollo and sending thousands of generic emails is an effective GTM strategy. 
 You should understand concepts such as: 
 * Account research * Segmentation * Buying signals * Trigger-based outreach * Personalized messaging * Multi-channel prospecting * AI-assisted research * CRM and pipeline management 
 You should constantly think: 
 **Why should this specific prospect care about what we are offering right now?** 
 Cold Calling 
 Cold calling is an important part of this role. 
 You should be comfortable: 
 * Calling prospects directly * Starting cold conversations * Getting through gatekeepers * Understanding the prospect's business problem * Handling objections * Identifying the right decision-maker * Converting relevant conversations into meetings 
 If you are uncomfortable picking up the phone and speaking to prospects, this role will not be a good fit. 
 Use AI in Your GTM Workflow 
 We are an AI-native company and expect our GTM team to operate similarly. 
 You should be comfortable using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI systems for: 
 * Account research * Prospect qualification * Company research * Personalization * Market analysis * Message iteration * Call preparation * Campaign analysis * Workflow automation 
 You do not need to know every AI tool available today. 
 However, you should understand how to use AI to become significantly more effective at sales and business development. 
 Generate Market Intelligence 
 Your job is not only to generate meetings. 
 Through outbound conversations and campaign data, you should also help us understand: 
 * Which industries have the strongest pain points * Which problems prospects care about * Which decision-makers respond * Common objections * Buying triggers * Why campaigns succeed or fail * How our positioning should evolve * Which ICPs we should pursue further 
 The insights you generate will directly influence the company's GTM strategy. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 You should have: 
 * 36 years of experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, Outbound Sales, or International Sales * Experience selling **IT services, software development services, AI/automation solutions, technology consulting, or similar B2B technology services** * Strong cold-calling experience * Experience generating outbound pipeline * Strong written and spoken English * Experience working with international prospects, preferably the US market * Good understanding of consultative / solution selling * Strong research and analytical skills * Experience working with CRM and prospecting tools * Ability to operate independently and take ownership * Comfort working directly with founders * High agency and bias toward action 
 Good to Have 
 Experience with: 
 * AI / Generative AI / Automation services * IT consulting or software development companies * US-market outbound * Apollo * LinkedIn Sales Navigator * Clay * HubSpot or similar CRMs * Cold email tools * Email deliverability * AI-assisted GTM workflows 
 This Role Is Not For You If 
 * Your outbound strategy is simply downloading lists and mass-emailing them * You only want inbound leads handed to you * You are unwilling to cold call * You measure success primarily by the number of emails sent * You need a mature sales playbook before you can operate * You have no experience selling technology or services * You are primarily looking for a people-management role 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Within the first few months, you should be able to: 
 * Build a structured outbound process * Test multiple ICPs and campaigns * Consistently generate qualified conversations * Identify which industries and messages are working * Build a repeatable prospecting process * Provide clear market insights based on real conversations * Create a predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities 
 The long-term objective is simple: 
 Build a repeatable outbound engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline for the company. 
 This is a high-ownership individual-contributor role. 
 If you enjoy experimenting with markets, talking to prospects, building outbound systems, and figuring out what actually makes customers buy, you will have significant ownership here.

Key Skills: Business Development,Database Building,Linkedin Marketing,Lead Generation,Cold Calling,Inside Sales,Online Lead Generation,Email Campaign

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a driven, commercially minded Business Development Manager to join our legal services team. This role goes beyond lead generation you will be responsible for connecting the firm's legal expertise with its market presence, owning the full BD lifecycle from prospect identification to client onboarding, and contributing meaningfully to the firm's overall business strategy. Key Responsibilities 

 1. Lead Generation & Client Development 
 Identify and research prospective clients and business opportunities. Manage the lead pipeline from initial enquiry through conversion into mandates. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients. Represent the firm at industry events, conferences, networking forums, and client meetings. 

 2. Client Experience & Operations 
 Own and manage the Corporate Practice inbox. Coordinate client onboarding and ensure smooth communication across internal teams. Coordinate billing, payment follow-ups, and retainer-related matters. Ensure a seamless and professional client experience throughout the engagement lifecycle. 

 3. Market Intelligence & Strategy 
 Track industry trends, competitor activity, and relevant regulatory developments. Identify cross-selling and business development opportunities across the firm's practice areas and advisory services. Support the preparation of pitches, proposals, presentations, and business development materials for senior management. Contribute to the firm's overall client acquisition and revenue growth strategy. 

 4. Content & Thought Leadership 
 Manage and coordinate the firm's LinkedIn presence. Coordinate legal updates, articles, newsletters, and thought-leadership content with lawyers. Support the firm's rankings and directory submissions, including Chambers, Legal 500, and IBLJ. 

 5. International Client Development 
 Support inbound mandates through international desks. Research target international organisations and potential clients. Identify and map outreach opportunities for cross-border legal work. 

 6. Business Strategy Support 
 Work closely with senior management on revenue growth and business development initiatives. Prepare and maintain BD reports, lead trackers, and performance updates. Support the development and implementation of the firm's long-term client acquisition and retention strategy. 

 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Law, Business, Communications, or a related field. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Client Management, or Sales within a law firm is mandatory. Prior experience working in a law firm is essential; candidates without law-firm experience will not be considered. Experience in legal services, professional services, or B2B client development will be preferred. Demonstrable track record of lead generation, lead conversion, and client relationship management. Strong command of written and spoken English; knowledge of a second Indian language will be an advantage. Confident, presentable, and composed in high-stakes client interactions. Ability to work independently and manage multiple workstreams with minimal supervision. Familiarity with legal industry structure, terminology, and client expectations. Experience with LinkedIn, CRM platforms, content marketing, and business development tools will be a strong advantage. Strong communication, networking, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. 

 Experience 
 Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in a Law Firm is mandatory. Joining 
 Immediate or as per notice period. If you are a dynamic and commercially driven professional with prior law-firm experience and are looking to grow in the legal consulting industry, we invite you to apply.

description:
About The Movera 
 The Movera is an Australia-focused moving and relocation company providing professional packing, moving and relocation solutions to customers across Australia. 
 We are looking for an experienced International Relocation Sales Executive Australian Market to join our Gurugram team. 
 This is NOT a generic telesales/BPO position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previous experience selling packing & moving, removalist, relocation or moving services to Australian or US customers . 
 Role & Responsibilities Handle inbound and outbound sales calls from customers in the Australian market. Understand customers' moving and relocation requirements. Explain suitable moving and packing solutions based on customer requirements. Prepare, present and follow up on quotations. Convert qualified enquiries and quotations into confirmed bookings. Follow up with leads consistently and professionally. Handle customer objections, negotiate and confidently close sales. Build strong relationships with customers throughout the sales process. Maintain accurate lead, quotation and follow-up information in the CRM. Coordinate with the operations team after booking confirmation. Achieve monthly sales, conversion and revenue targets. Preferred Candidate Profile 
 This section is extremely important. Please apply only if you meet the relevant experience requirements. 
 Mandatory Requirements Minimum 2 years of sales experience in the packing & moving, removalist, relocation or moving-services industry . Previous experience dealing with Australian or US customers/clients . Strong preference for candidates with Australian moving/removalist sales experience . Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation and professional phone etiquette. Strong persuasion, negotiation and objection-handling skills. Proven ability to convert enquiries/leads into confirmed sales or bookings. Confident handling customers over the phone. Experience with quotations, follow-ups and CRM/lead-management systems. Willingness to work from our Gurugram office during Australian business hours. 
 Who Should NOT Apply This role is specifically for experienced international moving/relocation sales professionals. Candidates with only generic telesales/BPO experience and no relevant packing & moving, removalist or relocation sales experience will not be considered . Experience from unrelated industries such as telecom, banking, insurance, credit cards or generic BPO/telesales does not meet the core requirement unless the candidate also has relevant moving/relocation sales experience. 
 Communication Skills The successful candidate must be highly confident and professional when communicating with Australian customers. You should be able to: 
 Build rapport quickly with customers. Understand customer requirements through effective questioning. Explain quotations clearly. Handle objections confidently. Negotiate professionally. Create urgency where appropriate. Close sales without being overly aggressive. Communicate naturally and professionally in English. Candidates with strong experience communicating with Australian, UK or US customers will be preferred. 
 Compensation & Benefits Competitive compensation , based on relevant experience, skills and suitability for the role. Transport/commute allowance as applicable. Performance-based monthly incentives. Opportunity for professional growth within a growing international relocation business.

title: Territory Sales Executive
description:
TERRITORY SALES EXECUTIVE - GENERAL TRADE 
 Industry: Imported Glassware / Tableware / Houseware 
 Department: General Trade Sales 
 Employment Type: Full-Time Field Sales 
 Working Days: 6 Days per Week 
 Salary: 26,000 - 45,000 per month + applicable TA/DA/Conveyance at Actuals/ 
 Mobile Allowance. 
 OPEN POSITIONS 
 Delhi / NCR - 2 Positions 
 Territory 1: North Delhi + West Delhi + GT Road Belt up to Ambala 
 Territory 2: South Delhi + East Delhi + Gurgaon + Faridabad 
 Kolkata / West Bengal - 1 Position 
 Territory: Kolkata + Entire West Bengal 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for energetic, street-smart and result-oriented Territory Sales Executives - General Trade to develop the market for a leading Imported Glassware Brand . 
This is a pure General Trade Field-sales role , focused on independent retail outlets such as: 
 Glassware and crockery shops 
 Kitchenware and cookware shops 
 Houseware and plastic household-product stores 
 Gift shops 
 Departmental stores 
 Independent neighborhood / mom-and-pop retailers 
 The sales channel is primarily: 
 Company to Distributor to Retailer to Consumer 
 The role will focus strongly on four areas: 
 DISTRIBUTOR STRENGTHENING 
 OUTLET COVERAGE 
 SECONDARY SALES 
 PRODUCT VISIBILITY 
 This is not a HORECA or Institutional Sales position. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Drive Secondary Sales 
Generate and grow secondary sales from distributors to General Trade retailers. Regularly visit retailers, present products, book orders, introduce new products and generate repeat business. 
The objective is to ensure continuous movement of products from: 
 Distributor to Retailer to Consumer 
 2. Increase Outlet Coverage 
 Continuously identify and develop new retail outlets in the assigned territory. Focus on increasing the number of productive outlets that actively stock, sell and reorder the Imported Glassware Brand. 
 Develop both: 
 New retailers 
 Existing retailers with additional sales potential 
 Approximately 70% focus on new business development and 30% focus on existing business development , depending on territory maturity. 
 3. Strengthen Distributors 
 Work closely with existing distributors to improve: 
 Market coverage 
 Retailer servicing 
 Product availability 
 Secondary sales 
 Stock movement 
 New-product distribution 
 Market penetration 
 Identify areas where distribution is weak or additional distributors may be required. Support the company in identifying suitable new distributor opportunities. 
 4. Improve Product Visibility 
Ensure good visibility and presentation of products at important retail outlets. 
Look for opportunities to improve: 
Shelf placement 
Counter displays 
Product presentation 
New-product visibility 
Range display 
Promotional material 
The objective is to make the products visible and easy for retailers to recommend to customers. 
 5. Increase Product Range Per Outlet 
 Encourage retailers to stock a wider range of products instead of only a few fast-moving items. 
 Focus on: 
 Increasing number of SKUs per outlet 
 Introducing new products 
 Expanding product categories 
 Improving repeat ordering 
 Developing higher-value retailers 
 6. Territory & Beat Management 
 Plan and cover the assigned territory systematically. 
 Develop: 
 Markets - Beats - Retailers - Visit Frequency 
 Maintain disciplined market coverage and regularly identify: 
 New outlets 
 Underdeveloped markets 
 Inactive retailers 
 Distribution gaps 
 Competitor activity 
 New sales opportunities 
 7. Year-on-Year Sales Growth 
 Take ownership of sales growth in the assigned territory. 
 Sales targets will be planned considering: 
 Previous-year sales 
 Existing business 
 Territory potential 
 Outlet opportunities 
 Distributor strength 
 New product opportunities 
 Performance will be strongly evaluated on Year-on-Year sales growth . 
 8. New Product Introduction 
 Actively present and introduce new products to distributors and retailers. 
 The salesperson should be comfortable explaining: 
 Product features 
 Design and usage 
 MRP 
 Retail potential 
 Product dierentiation 
 Consumer appeal 
 9. Market Intelligence 
 Regularly provide feedback on: 
 Competitor brands 
 Competitor pricing 
 New launches 
 Retailer feedback 
 Product trends 
 Retail margins 
 Market opportunities 
 Fast- and slow-moving products 
 Distributor and retailer activity 
 COLLECTION RESPONSIBILITY 
 The Territory Sales Executive will be responsible only for Sales and Market Development . 
 Retailer payment collection will be handled by the respective distributor. 
 IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE 
 Experience 
 2 to 5 years of relevant General Trade Field-sales experience preferred. 
 Candidates may come from: 
 Glassware 
 Crockery 
 Tableware 
 Kitchenware 
 Cookware 
 Plasticware / Plastic Household Products 
 Houseware / Homeware 
 Giftware 
 Utensils 
 Small Home Appliances 
 FMCG / Consumer Goods with strong General Trade experience 
 Direct glassware experience is preferred but not mandatory. 
 Strong candidates from Cookware, Kitchenware, Plastic Household Products, Crockery or Houseware are highly relevant. 
 Candidates primarily experienced in HORECA, Hotels, Restaurants or Institutional Sales without meaningful General Trade experience will not be suitable. 
 SKILLS & PERSONAL QUALITIES 
The ideal candidate should be: 
 Strong in General Trade sales 
 Street-smart and energetic 
 Comfortable working extensively in the market 
 Good at retailer relationship building 
 Strong in new outlet opening 
 Experienced in secondary sales 
 Good at distributor coordination 
 Target-oriented 
 Self-driven and disciplined 
 Strong in follow-up 
 Comfortable working independently 
 Commercially aware 
 Willing to travel regularly 
 
 Knowledge of MS Word or Excel is beneficial 
 VEHICLE & TRAVEL 
 Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence are preferred / required depending on the territory. 
 The candidate should be comfortable with extensive local travel and outstation travel wherever required. 
 WORKING DAYS 
 This is a 6-day Field-sales position . 
 Weekly off will normally be: Sunday OR the weekly closure day of the principal market being covered. 
 TERRITORY DETAILS 
 NORTH & WEST DELHI / GT ROAD BELT 
 North Delhi, West Delhi and markets along the GT Road belt up to Ambala. Candidates already familiar with retailers and distributors in these markets will be preferred. 
 SOUTH & EAST DELHI / NCR 
 South Delhi, East Delhi, Gurgaon and Faridabad. 
 Existing General Trade market knowledge will be preferred. 
 KOLKATA / WEST BENGAL 
 Based in Kolkata with responsibility for the entire West Bengal market . 
 Regular outstation travel across West Bengal will be required. 
 Knowledge of the West Bengal General Trade market and ability to communicate in Bengali and Hindi will be preferred. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS 
 Performance will primarily be evaluated on: 
 
 Distributor Strengthening 
 Distributor productivity 
 Market coverage 
 Product availability 
 New distributor opportunities 
 Outlet Coverage 
 New outlets opened 
 Productive outlets developed 
 Existing outlet growth 
 New market penetration 
 Secondary Sales 
 Secondary sales growth 
 Year-on-Year sales growth 
 Repeat orders 
 New-product sales 
 Product Visibility 
 Product placement 
 Range visibility 
 New-product displays 
 Retail presence 
 WHO SHOULD APPLY? 
 Apply if you can confidently say: 
 I know General Trade. I can strengthen distributors, increase outlet coverage, drive secondary sales, improve product visibility and grow my territory year after year. 
We are looking for a strong market developer and salesperson , not merely an order taker.

Have strong verbal and written communication skills to support the senior team to develop quality materials such as press releases, messages etc. Maintain relationships with prominent media members inside and outside your clients industries and stay current on any news that can be used for the benefit of clients Be responsible to create professional, actionable client-facing communications, status reports, campaign summary reports and general account activity reports. That s why it s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view-your talent-is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
